researchDraft.querySummary: Six independent, cross-validated signals from the dossier were selected. They span: a US-Iran direct-fire escalation in the Strait of Hormuz with oil/gas spikes; a global monetary tightening turn led by a 66% September Fed hike probability and higher ECB bets; NVIDIA's circular-finance move ($3.5bn MediaTek convertible plus $3.5bn Anthropic-Lambda compute deal); Texas freezing data-center grid connections and the ghost-demand reckoning; export controls shifting from hardware to compute identity while CXMT starts HBM3E risk production; and a G20 rift over Russia's return alongside Kyiv strikes and an AI-power agenda.

en.title: US-Iran direct fire in the Strait of Hormuz sends oil and European gas prices soaring
en.coreFact: On Aug 30, U.S. forces struck IRGC rocket launchers on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz; Iran retaliated with missiles at two U.S. bases in Jordan and at the UAE. On Sep 1, CENTCOM said U.S. forces began striking IRGC targets inside Iran for a second day. Two tankers leaving the Strait were hit by unidentified projectiles. WTI settled up 5.2% at $90.22, Brent up 4.6% at $94.65, Murban up 7.3%, and European TTF gas rose 6.2% to €74.14/MWh, the highest since January 2023.
en.whyItMatters: Energy security has switched from a potential risk to a live supply-chain event. With actual disruption risk in Hormuz and European gas at three-year highs, AI data-center power costs and economy-wide inflation will rise. Bessent says Iran's economy may collapse within weeks or months and new banking sanctions are expected this week, putting energy, finance, and geopolitics on a high-frequency escalation path.

zh.title: 美伊在霍尔木兹海峡直接交火，油价与欧洲气价同步跳涨
zh.coreFact: 8月30日，美军打击霍尔木兹海峡拉腊克岛上的IRGC火箭发射架；伊朗向约旦两处美军基地及阿联酋发射导弹报复。9月1日，CENTCOM宣布美军连续第二日打击伊朗境内IRGC目标。两艘驶出霍尔木兹海峡的油轮遭不明来源射弹击中。WTI收涨5.2%至90.22美元/桶，布伦特涨4.6%至94.65美元/桶，Murban原油涨7.3%，欧洲TTF天然气涨6.2%至74.14欧元/兆瓦时，为2023年1月以来最高。
zh.whyItMatters: 能源安全已从“潜在风险”切换为“实时供应链事件”。霍尔木兹实际断供风险与欧洲气价三年高点同时出现，将直接抬升AI数据中心用电成本与全行业通胀。贝森特称伊朗经济数周或数月内可能崩溃，并预告本周宣布对伊银行制裁，能源-金融-地缘联动进入高频加码状态。

en.title: Global monetary shift confirmed: Fed September hike odds jump to 66%, ECB bets rise
en.coreFact: On Sep 1, Fed Governor Barr said he favors rate hikes unless inflation convincingly returns to 2%; CPI was 3.7% y/y and core 3.3%. CME FedWatch put the probability of a September 15-16 FOMC hike at about 66%, up from just over 30% before Warsh's Jackson Hole speech. Barclays reversed its previous no-hike view to forecast 25bp hikes in September and December. Eurozone August CPI flash came in at 3.3%, the highest of 2026, strengthening ECB tightening expectations.
en.whyItMatters: This is the first head-on collision between the AI capex boom and energy-driven inflation. Fed officials explicitly cite AI infrastructure investment as an inflation driver, and tighter money will raise financing costs for this year's roughly $700bn data-center spending. Macro constraints are now visibly feeding back into the AI infrastructure race.

zh.title: 全球货币转向确认：美联储9月加息概率跳升至66%，欧央行加息押注升温
zh.coreFact: 9月1日，美联储理事巴尔表示，除非通胀令人信服地回到2%，否则支持加息；当前CPI同比3.7%、核心3.3%。CME FedWatch显示9月15-16日FOMC加息概率约66%，沃什杰克逊霍尔讲话前仅略高于30%。巴克莱逆转年内按兵不动的预期，改为预测9月与12月各加息25bp。欧元区8月CPI初值3.3%，为2026年内最高，强化欧央行加息预期。
zh.whyItMatters: 这是“AI资本开支繁荣”与“能源通胀”的正面碰撞。美联储官员明确将AI基础设施投资列为通胀推手，收紧货币将直接抬高今年约7000亿美元规模数据中心开支的融资成本。宏观约束第一次明确反作用于AI基础设施竞赛进程。

en.title: NVIDIA's 'circular finance': $3.5bn MediaTek stake plus $3.5bn Anthropic-Lambda compute deal
en.coreFact: On Sep 1, NVIDIA deepened its partnership with MediaTek by subscribing to $3.5bn of convertible bonds, its largest single overseas direct investment. On Aug 31, WSJ reported Anthropic signed a $35bn cloud-compute deal with NVIDIA-backed Lambda; NVIDIA holds a lease at Hut 8's Texas data center (about 350-700MW), effectively providing credit backing for below-investment-grade Anthropic. Anthropic's 2026 compute commitments now total about $80bn. Lambda is in talks to raise up to $3bn at a valuation up to $12bn.
en.whyItMatters: AI infrastructure's capital structure is being rewritten: chip vendors are becoming financiers and landlords, erasing the boundary of the 'picks-and-shovels' seller. This structure sits in Texas, the same region where grid connections have just been frozen, putting chip capital and grid regulation into direct confrontation.

en.title: Texas freezes data-center grid connections: 'ghost demand' reckoning begins
en.coreFact: On Sep 1, Reuters reported Texas became the first major hub to freeze new data-center interconnection applications and launched a full audit requiring disclosure of ultimate owners, water use, incentive dependence, and self-supply power plans. ERCOT's queue has surged from about 48GW in 2023 to more than 474GW. Reuters verification put major-user requests across the Midwest, Mid-Atlantic, and South at over 700GW—more than 10 times current U.S. data-center electricity use. After financial guardrails appeared, Exelon cut high-probability demand about 40% to 11GW; Ohio's AEP Ohio pipeline halved; PJM's last four auctions saw $29.4bn increase in capacity costs from data-center demand. Pennsylvania's Aug 18 order: only 20 of 100+ proposed data centers filed permits.
en.whyItMatters: The underlying assumption of the AI infrastructure race—unlimited demand, bottlenecks only on supply—is shifting to one where demand must be verified and queue-squatting is no longer an asset. Speculative 'ghost demand' is being cleared, reshaping expectations for power, land, and capital allocation and directly hitting the NVIDIA-Anthropic-utility valuation chain.

zh.title: 德州冻结数据中心并网：“幽灵需求”清算开始
zh.coreFact: 9月1日，路透调查报道，德州成为首个冻结新数据中心并网申请的主要枢纽，并启动全面审计（要求披露最终所有者、用水、激励依赖、自备电源计划）。ERCOT并网申请量从2023年的约48GW飙升至474GW以上；路透核查显示美国中西部、中大西洋、南部大用户申请总量超过700GW，约为当前数据中心实际用电量的10倍以上。加财务护栏后需求显著蒸发：Exelon将高概率需求下调约40%至11GW；AEP Ohio管道减半；PJM近四次拍卖因数据中心需求使容量成本增加294亿美元。宾州8月18日跟进：100多个拟建数据中心仅20个提交许可申请。
zh.whyItMatters: AI基础设施竞赛的底层假设从“需求无限、瓶颈只在供给”转向“需求需要验证、排队即资产的时代结束”。投机性占位（幽灵需求）被清除，将重塑电力、土地、资本配置预期，并直接冲击英伟达-Anthropic-公用事业链条的估值逻辑。

en.title: Export-control paradigm shifts to 'compute identity' as US drafts rules, Korea expands list, CXMT approaches HBM3E
en.coreFact: Forbes reported a Commerce Department internal group is drafting new AI chip export rules that would regulate who uses compute—data-center location, lessees, and training models—rather than only where chips sit, targeting Chinese AI firms renting Nvidia GPUs in third countries like Thailand. The trigger: Kimi K3's near-frontier performance, which White House OSTP Director Krazios publicly accused of stealing Anthropic technology and training on Nvidia GB300 servers in Thailand. South Korea's new strategic-goods list took effect Sep 1, adding high-performance AI chips, lithography/etch/deposition equipment, and DNA synthesizers. China's CXMT began small-batch HBM3E risk production and plans expansion by 2027.
en.whyItMatters: Technology control is moving from 'control of things' to 'control of people/compute identity,' extending the boundary almost without limit. The channel for Chinese AI firms to rent compute via third countries is being systematically blocked, while China's HBM self-research breakthrough erodes the effectiveness of U.S. memory controls. Bessent says all options are on the table for Iran/China sanctions, linking financial secondary sanctions to tech control.

zh.title: 出口管制范式转向“算力身份”——美新规草案、韩国扩清单、长鑫HBM3E突破同步出现
zh.coreFact: 福布斯报道，美国商务部内部小组正起草新的AI芯片出口管制规则——监管对象从“芯片硬件在哪”转向“谁在使用算力”（数据中心位置、租赁方、训练何种模型均纳入），直接针对中国AI企业经第三国（如泰国）云端租用英伟达GPU的行为。导火索是月之暗面Kimi K3模型逼近美国前沿水平，白宫科技政策办公室主任克拉齐奥斯公开指控其窃取Anthropic技术并经泰国英伟达GB300服务器训练。韩国9月1日生效新战略物项清单，新增高性能AI芯片、光刻/刻蚀/沉积设备、核酸合成仪。中国长鑫存储开始小批量HBM3E风险量产，计划2027年扩产。

en.title: G20 rift: U.S. invites Russian finance minister back, EU refuses normalization, Kyiv hit by mass strike the same night
en.coreFact: On Aug 31, Russian Finance Minister Siluanov unexpectedly appeared at the U.S.-hosted G20 finance ministers' meeting in Asheville; the invitation was a unilateral U.S. decision without prior European consultation. On Sep 1, EU Economic Commissioner Dombrovskis said it is not time to normalize Russia's presence; European ministers and central bankers refused to appear in the G20 family photo with Siluanov. German Finance Minister Klingbeil said no normalization while the war continues. That same night, Russia launched a massive air strike on Kyiv, killing at least 12. In the same G20 week, Musk and Zuckerberg called for more AI data centers and power at the G20 innovation ministers' meeting.
en.whyItMatters: The U.S. is unilaterally pushing to institutionalize Russia's return to the G20 during wartime, colliding head-on with Europe's refusal to normalize—a visible crack in Western alliance cohesion. At the same time, the U.S. is using its G20 hosting to advance an AI-power agenda, pulling AI infrastructure into international institutional discourse. Fragmentation and realignment are happening in the same window.

zh.title: G20裂痕——美国邀俄财长回归，欧盟拒绝正常化，基辅同夜遭大规模打击
zh.coreFact: 8月31日，美国主办G20财长会（北卡阿什维尔）上，俄财长西卢安诺夫意外现身——邀请系美方单方面发出，未事先与欧洲协商。9月1日，欧盟经济委员东布罗夫斯基斯明确表示“现在不是将俄罗斯在场正常化的时候”；欧洲部长与央行行长拒绝与西卢安诺夫同框拍摄G20全家福；德国财长克林贝尔称战争持续期间不接受正常化。同夜，俄罗斯对基辅发动大规模空袭，至少12人死亡。同一G20周，马斯克与扎克伯格在G20创新部长会上呼吁建设更多AI数据中心与电力。
zh.whyItMatters: 美国在战争进行中单方面推动俄罗斯回归G20制度化，与欧洲拒绝正常化正面冲突——西方联盟在机构层面的凝聚力出现可见裂缝。同时美国借主办G20推动“AI-电力”议程，将AI基建话语纳入其主持的国际议程。同一事件窗口内分裂与重组并存。
